description.value: Sweet Puffin is a dessert cafe and bubble tea shop in Burnaby offering a range of desserts and refreshing beverages. Customers can call ahead for takeout orders or enjoy indoor seating for a casual stop. It's a convenient spot for touring cyclists to grab sweets and drinks between rides.
